findings.highlight: As he sheds the tears of one so horribly grieved...
findings.evidenceJa: 流れる涙を懸命にかみ殺して。
findings.governingReading: He desperately tries to bite back the flowing tears.
findings.explanation: Struggling to suppress tears becomes simply shedding them.

findings.highlight: Apologizing to those he must climb over, but unwavering in his chosen path.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が踏みつけてきたもの全てに頭を下げて、それでも、彼は道を曲げないと言い切った。
findings.governingReading: He bows toward everything he has already trampled, but will not change his path.
findings.explanation: Bowing to what he has trodden on becomes apologizing to what he must climb over.

findings.highlight: And she, who could not even believe his words, was weak...
findings.evidenceJa: 彼の言葉を否定するだけだった自分こそが、その道を間違えていた—
findings.governingReading: She judges herself, who only denied his words, to have mistaken her own course.
findings.explanation: Her path was mistaken becomes she was weak.

findings.highlight: The priests words, while easy to understand, are anathema to everything she believes in and stands for.
findings.evidenceJa: 神父の言葉が理解できないのではなく、彼女の中には、そんな選択肢は存在すらしていなかったのだ。
findings.governingReading: The option never existed in her mind, not a failure to comprehend the words.
findings.explanation: An unimagined choice becomes anathema to all her beliefs.

findings.highlight: The priests words, while easy to understand, are anathema to everything she believes in and stands for.
findings.evidenceJa: 神父の言葉が理解できないのではなく、彼女の中には、そんな選択肢は存在すらしていなかったのだ。
findings.governingReading: The words belong to the singular priest.

findings.highlight: He lays at her feet, breathing raggedly.
findings.evidenceJa: 足下には、苦しげに呼吸をする、彼女の主が倒れている。
findings.governingReading: The Master lies fallen at her feet.
findings.explanation: The prone boy lays without an object.
